note: Owner policy for entity occurrences matched inside a URL rather than in the prose of a drop. Ruled 2026-08-16. Governs the URL cleanup stage; nothing here has been applied yet.
why: An entity mention is a claim that Q named something. A slug in a content-management system, or a search term Q typed into a query string, is not Q naming a thing — it is an artefact of the link he pasted. Painting those as prose entities inflates every count that rests on them and puts a highlight on words the reader cannot see in the drop. A publisher's domain is different: it is real information about where the material came from, and it belongs where sources are listed rather than where Q's words are.

url_path_fragment.reason: A path slug is generated by the publisher's CMS, not written by Q.

url_query_fragment.reason: A search term in a query string records what Q looked for, not what he said.

hostname_source_reference.ruling: Genuine source information, but NOT a prose entity mention. Migrate into linked-source metadata.
hostname_source_reference.reason: The domain identifies the publisher of the linked material. That is worth keeping and worth showing — as a source, not as a word Q wrote.

human_readable_link_label.ruling: MAY qualify as an entity mention when the visible text explicitly names the entity.
human_readable_link_label.reason: If a reader can see the name in the drop, it is prose, and the URL beside it is incidental.
human_readable_link_label.note: Empty in the current quarantine by construction: a record only reaches the quarantine when the term appears NOWHERE in the prose, which is the opposite of a visible label. The class exists so a future pass that finds one has somewhere to put it.

ambiguous_url_reference.ruling: Retain unchanged and send to private review.
ambiguous_url_reference.reason: The match spans more than one part of the URL, so no automatic decision is safe.

linkedSourceMetadata.purpose: Where a hostname reference goes instead of the prose layer.
mustPreserve: postNum — the drop the link appeared in
url — the full original URL, unmodified
entityId — the permanent qe- id, only when confidently resolved
reason — the evidence and classification that put it here
originalOccurrence — the extracted text exactly as the audit matched it
migratedFrom — the migration history: what it was, when it moved, and under which ruling
linkedSourceMetadata.afterMigration: No hostname, path or query substring is painted as a prose entity.

appliesTo: audit/entity-hover-url-quarantine.json — 441 quarantined hover records, and the certified entity occurrences behind them.
status: RULED, NOT APPLIED. The count-changing cleanup is prepared separately and needs its own approval.
